RESIDENTIAL PURCHASE AGREEMENT, DECLARATION OF COVENANTS AND CONSTRUCTION SUBCONTRACT

This instrument comprises the agreement for the purchase and sale of the residential dwelling at 118 Alder Lane, built in 1954, between Westhaven Homes LLC ("Seller") and the individual purchaser identified on the signature page ("Buyer"); the declaration of covenants recorded against the subdivision; and the subcontract between Seller and Pierpoint Mechanical, Inc. ("Subcontractor").

1. Purchase and Sale

1.1 Seller shall sell and Buyer shall purchase the Property for the purchase price set out in Schedule 1.

1.2 Closing shall occur within sixty (60) days of the Effective Date.

2. Declaration of Covenants

2.1 No lot in the subdivision shall be sold, conveyed, leased or occupied by any person who is not of the Caucasian race, nor by any person on account of color, religion, sex, familial status, national origin or disability.

2.2 Each lot shall be used for single-family residential purposes only.

3. Construction Subcontract

3.1 Subcontractor shall indemnify, defend and hold harmless Seller from and against any and all claims, damages, losses and expenses arising out of or relating to the Work, including claims arising out of Seller's sole negligence and Seller's willful misconduct, without limitation of any kind.

3.2 Subcontractor shall maintain commercial general liability insurance naming Seller as an additional insured.

4. Disclosures

4.1 Seller has provided Buyer with the disclosures Seller deems appropriate.

IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the parties have executed this instrument.

WESTHAVEN HOMES LLC

By: _______________________
Name: _____________________
Title: ____________________

BUYER
